## Monitors

Monitors show data from **Logic Video Connections**. This can be either from a [camera](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Video/Cameras "Wiki/Building/Components/Video/Cameras"), or a [Lua script](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Game_Mechanics/Lua "Wiki/Game Mechanics/Lua").
Monitors can be mirrored, which also mirrors the video signal!

[![Video Connection](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/b3/Video_Connection.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20200129200527)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/b3/Video_Connection.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200129200527)

HUD 1x1

[![HUD 1x1](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/ea/HUD_1x1.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/100?cb=20200129200933)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/ea/HUD_1x1.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129200933)

- can be transparent from the front (side with the video on it)
- always transparent from the back
- 32x32 pixels

HUD 3x3

[![HUD 3x3](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/8a/HUD_3x3.png/revision/latest?cb=20200129201004)

- can be transparent from the front (side with the video on it)
- always transparent from the back
- 96x96 pixels
